pruning: Nothing of Wuffs is vendored: the library is compat.wuffs 0.3.6, release/c/wuffs-v0.3.c of the same tag archive compiled as C++ under WUFFS_IMPLEMENTATION. Its README, LICENSE and AUTHORS are retained here. The conformance run (tools/run_conformance.py) builds upstream's example/convert-to-nia from the same archive and compares it, image by image over test/data, with the port in examples/convert-to-nia written against the module.
